page.overview:
Who is Venus and Adonis?

In this poem Venus (Aphrodite: the goddess of love) falls in love for a man named Adonis. She tries to get him to love her but he would rather hunt with his friends. One day he got killed by a bear. He turned into a flower in which Venus plucked and kept between her breasts. Category:Females Category:Characters Category:Males
